description: Access to SYS1.RACFDS or a backup/copy exposes legacy-DES lab hashes that can be converted with racf2john and cracked with john-sim in vulnerable Gibson training mode.
expected_smf_records: 119 FTP/TCP EXFILTRATION IF HASH DATASET TRANSFERRED
forensic_questions: Was the access permitted by SPECIAL, explicit PERMIT or warning mode?
Did racf2john or john execute in OMVS?
Were hashes written to another dataset?
Was that dataset transferred over FTP/TCP?
